name: Original Skeleton retained corpse physical presentation sanitized

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local anim=require('openmw.animation')
local t=0;local hurt=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during genuine Skeleton contact')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c2ed));assert(a and a:isValid())
 local health=types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(a).current
 assert(types.Actor.isDead(a),'Retained original Skeleton must remain dead')
 print('CryptSkeleton corpse bounds='..tostring(a:getBoundingBox().center)..' dead='..tostring(types.Actor.isDead(a)))
 if types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current<109.99 then print('CryptSkeleton retaliation player hurt') end
 local skill=types.NPC.stats.skills.bluntweapon(self)
 if (a.position-self.position):length()<65 then print('CryptSkeleton retaliation in reach') end
 if anim.hasAnimation(a) then print('CryptSkeleton retaliation animation lower='..tostring(anim.getActiveGroup(a,anim.BONE_GROUP.LowerBody))..' torso='..tostring(anim.getActiveGroup(a,anim.BONE_GROUP.Torso))) end
 print('CryptSkeleton contact sample health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' enemy_health='..health..' distance='..(a.position-self.position):length()..' blunt='..skill.base..' progress='..skill.progress)
 if health<20 then hurt=true end
 if hurt then print('CryptSkeleton contact hurt') end
 local dv=a.position-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*dv.x-f.x*dv.y,f.x*dv.x+f.y*dv.y)
 print(string.format('CryptSkeleton contact aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5)))))
end}}}}
